data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a deterioration in prior-year claims reserves of $7.832m (approximately 1.16% of opening gross claims outstanding of $673.033m) in 2021. The adverse development was driven primarily by adverse incurred claims development in the NonMarine Liability (thirdparty liability) portfolio, including a number of individual large losses and effects of social inflation, with a material contribution from prior accident year reserve strengthening. Separately, a severe frequency of natural catastrophe events in 2021 materially impacted the current year result but the explicit prior-year reserve movement cited relates to liability reserve deterioration.
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of $7,832,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $6,620,000).
adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years in the Non-Marine Liability class.
further adverse loss experience in the Construction and Binders sub-classes from a number of individual large losses.
The class has been further affected by social inflation, whereby we have seen an increase in the frequency of claims and a higher percentage of insureds making claims.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure ($7.832m) is taken from the narrative note stating a 'deterioration of $7,832,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end'. The note does not explicitly label this amount gross or net of reinsurance; it is presented as part of 'net calendar year claims incurred' language. A specific closed-year prior-year adverse movement for 2018 of $4.1m is explicitly stated (used above for Casualty LOB). The 2017 and prior reserves were reinsured to Syndicate 1994 which removes those years from the triangle and may distort comparisons; RITC activity (2017 & prior) is noted in the accounts.
